finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a filename that includes shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the filename input before using it to open a file.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code does not involve any OS command execution. The filename is used only to open a file with ifstream, which does not execute the file as a command. There is no evidence of shell metacharacter interpretation or command execution.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code does not involve any OS command execution. There is no evidence of shell metacharacters or commands being executed based on the provided code.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can control the winner variable, which could include shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the winner variable before using it in the output.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The 'winner' variable is derived from the 'votes' map, which is populated by reading candidate names from a file. There is no indication that the 'winner' variable can be influenced by untrusted input or shell metacharacters. The program does not execute any OS commands, and the output is purely textual.
